summary: D.C. statehood advocates are intensifying their grassroots efforts ahead of the midterm elections, with Council members and advocacy groups traveling beyond the District to build support for statehood while also highlighting the consequences of federal control over D.C.'s security. A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood in upcoming legislative work. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
